form: A complete answer must specify the exact subset \(\mathcal D\subseteq\{3,4,5,\ldots\}\), by an explicit list or an equivalent precise membership rule valid for every integer \(n\ge3\). It must establish existence of a fixed admissible manifold and metric with the required blow-up sequence in every included dimension, and nonexistence in every excluded dimension.
not_enough: Examples in only some dimensions, exclusions in only some dimensions, upper or lower bounds on a possible dimension threshold, a conjectural classification, or a statement that the set is unknown would not determine the exact set.
